children: Vivakor Inc. (VIVK) filed a Form 8K - Unregistered Sales of Equity - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on October 09, 2026.

As previously reported, on July 9, 2025, the Company issued a junior secured convertible promissory note (the "Second Note") to J.J. Astor & Co. (the "J.J. Astor"), in the principal amount of $5,940,000 (the "Principal Amount"), in relation to a Loan and Security Agreement by and between the Company, its subsidiaries, and J.J. Astor (the "Loan Agreement"). The Company received $4,400,000, before fees.

Between October 5, 2026 and October 6, 2026, the Company received Notices of Conversion from J.J. Astor converting an aggregate of $350,000 of the amount due under the Second Note into an aggregate of 128,965 shares of the Company's common stock (the "J.J. Astor Shares"). Pursuant to the terms of the Second Note and the Notices of Conversion, the Company issued the J.J. Astor Shares. The J.J. Astor Shares were issued without a Rule 144 restrictive legend pursuant to a legal opinion received by the Company and its transfer agent. The issuances of the foregoing securities were exempt from registration pursuant to Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act promulgated thereunder as the holder is an accredited investor and familiar with our operations.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1450704/000182912626010995/vivakorinc_8k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1450704/000182912626010995/0001829126-26-010995-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
